column1: # materials.csv — the single source of truth for material properties.

# block fetching a local CSV from a file:// page.

#   key                     stable id used in the URL hash — do not rename casually
#   name                    what the dropdown shows
#   condition               temper / heat treatment the numbers belong to
#   density_kg_m3           mass density
#   youngs_modulus_gpa      E
#   poissons_ratio          nu

column1: #   shear_strength_mpa      ultimate shear strength
#   cte_um_m_k              linear thermal expansion
#   friction_dry            static coefficient against ITSELF

#   source                  where the numbers came from

# interface rather than of a material
